description: Get the live state of the aeX402 AMM on Robinhood Chain (EVM 4663) — the diamond-contract port of the Solana AMM. The AMM is the set of GRADUATED launchpad coins whose pools are seeded in-diamond on the canonical launchpad (0xED2F); this enumerates them live by scanning VPoolGraduated events + reading each pool's reserves, so it tracks reality as coins graduate. Returns graduatedPools[] (poolId, token, reserves, TVL), graduatedPoolCount, and status ("live" | "no-graduated-pools" | "unknown"), plus the legacy standalone 0xA1F6 USDG/WETH pool (legacy-drained). Distinct from the chain's Uniswap-fork DEX. No inputs.
name: aex402_rh_pool
